acceptedHighFindings.rationale: Temporary release-owner risk acceptance for the existing production exposure while restoring delivery of independently verified fixes. On 2026-10-03 KST, all six last-successful production image digests still report this exact High identity and Debian has no fixed gcc-14 package. The upstream fix changes the PBDS binary_heap erase_if header; absence of headers or direct calls does not prove prebuilt dependencies unreachable. Academy exploitability remains unknown, including crash or memory-corruption risk. This is not a false-positive or remediation claim. Accept only this exact identity until 2026-10-09 UTC, with no automatic renewal, no Critical acceptance and no other High identity. Every candidate still requires six fresh completed scans, isolated development/preprod, compatible migration, health-gated replacement and runtime/affected-flow verification. Owner and source evidence: docs/operations/container-image-security.md.
